items.title: Wells Fargo downgrades Roku to equal weight after strong second quarter
items.summary: Investing.com -- Wells Fargo downgraded Roku to Equal Weight from Overweight on Friday, saying the streaming platform's strong second-quarter results had lifted its estimates but left limited upside to its valuation as the company moves toward its planned acquisition by Fox Corp.

items.title: Fox upgraded to overweight as Roku deal, ad strength lift outlook
items.summary: Investing.com -- Fox Corp. was upgraded to Overweight from Neutral by J.P. Morgan and Wells Fargo, which also raised their price targets, citing stronger earnings prospects, robust advertising trends and the pending acquisition of Roku.

items.title: Fox Shares Jump After JPMorgan Upgrade and Higher Price Target
items.summary: Fox Corp (NASDAQ:FOX) Class A shares climbed 4. 1% in pre-market trading to $68.

items.title: Disney Stopped Leading With Its Own Headline Growth Number
items.summary: The consolidated earnings-growth metric, that management once led with, no longer opens its remarks, and the businesses the replacement metrics measure move at very different speeds.

items.title: Fox Corporation Stock Outlook: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish?
items.summary: Fox Corporation has underperformed the broader market over the past year, but analysts are cautiously optimistic about the stock’s prospects.

items.title: Fox (FOXA) Stock Looks Undervalued On Earnings But Fairly Valued On Cash Flow
items.summary: After a strong three year run that has seen Fox return 96.5%, the stock now sits in an interesting spot where a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) estimate points to a level close to its current price, while market multiples still screen it as undervalued. Fox has delivered a 96.5% return over the last three years, which means recent buyers are coming in after a long period of gains rather than at the start of a move.
